title: Windows prerequisites list
description: A <repo>/win-prereqs.json (packages only) or a dotfiles hosts/win-<hostname>.json (repos plus host-only packages), read by powershell/bin/Install-Prereqs.ps1.

repos.description: Host files only: the repos whose win-prereqs.json this host also installs, in order.

name.description: The package's name across every list; two entries with one name must agree on everything but why.

why.description: Evidence of use in the owning repo: at least one path:line.

command.description: An executable whose presence on PATH counts as installed, by whatever tool (the WindowsApps Store stubs do not count).

slow.description: A warning printed before installing it, for a large or slow install.

install.description: Manager specs, tried in order until one works.

checkOnly.description: Must be present, but is never installed or upgraded here.

manager.description: choco and winget run in the elevated pass; npm (-g), pip (--user, into the Python python3 runs), uv (uv tool) and psgallery (Install-Module -Scope CurrentUser) run unelevated.

version.description: A pin: installed at exactly this version, and changed only when the installed version differs.

source.description: npm only: install from this GitHub repository instead of the registry.
